DebugHandler.Stacktrace.desc: Builds a readable stack trace string, filtering out debughandler/SafeCall noise frames and eliding the middle when it exceeds maxStackLength (7).

DebugHandler.SafeWrap.desc: Wraps a table in a proxy table/closure so that calls into its functions automatically go through the Chili error handler (return values are not wrapped).

params.t_orig: Table to wrap (a link table instead gets its metatable __index rewritten).

DebugHandler.SafeWrap.returns: Wrapped table; non-table input is returned as-is.

DebugHandler.GetWidgetOrigin.desc: Walks up the call stack inspecting locals and function environments to find the user widget that created this chili object.
DebugHandler.GetWidgetOrigin.returns: The widget object, or nil if none is found.

DebugHandler:RegisterObject.desc: Registers a newly created chili object: stores obj._widget and appends it to the owning widget's list and allObjects (weak tables).

module.summary: Debugging and error containment: object registry, trimmed stack traces, SafeCall/xpcall wrapping of callbacks, and disposing widget-owned objects on unload.

fileDesc: Chili debugging support: registers every chili object, produces truncated stack traces, catches errors through the xpcall-based SafeCall, and disposes a widget's owned objects when it is removed.
